"""Verify a documentation-only workbook correction against its audited original."""

import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import openpyxl

from pu_toolbox.utils.serialization import file_hash
from scripts.audit_survey_workbook import KEY_FIELDS

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
delivery_path = WORK / "P2.1_workbook_correction_20261008.delivery.json"
delivery = json.loads(delivery_path.read_text())
original = ROOT / "P2.1_results_645runs_20261003(1).xlsx"
corrected = WORK / "P2.1_results_645runs_20261008_corrected.xlsx"
generator = WORK / "flatten_p21p22_runs_corrected_20261008.py"
reference = json.loads((ROOT / "docs/research/pu_survey/data/p2_2_artifacts_index.json").read_text())
assert delivery["schema_version"] == "p21-workbook-correction-1"
for name, path in (("original_workbook", original), ("corrected_workbook", corrected), ("generator", generator)):
    assert path.stat().st_size == delivery[name]["bytes"]
    assert file_hash(path) == delivery[name]["sha256"]
assert delivery["original_workbook"]["sha256"] == reference["release_table"]["sha256"]
assert delivery["original_workbook"]["bytes"] == reference["release_table"]["bytes"]
assert delivery["old_artifact_index_modified"] is False and delivery["acceptance_status_changed"] is False
old_audit = json.loads((WORK / "original_workbook_audit_fixed.json").read_text())
strict_new = json.loads((WORK / "corrected_against_old_index_fixed.json").read_text())
assert old_audit["ok"] and not old_audit["problems"]
assert not strict_new["ok"] and set(strict_new["problems"]) == {
    "workbook sha256 differs from release index", "workbook size differs from release index",
}
assert not strict_new["readme_correction_requests"]
books = [openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=False) for path in (original, corrected)]
try:
    assert books[0].sheetnames == books[1].sheetnames == ["runs", "P2.2 汇总", "readme", "coverage"]
    sheets, formula_count = {}, 0
    new_values = {}
    for sheet, expected_rows in (("runs", 645), ("P2.2 汇总", 183), ("coverage", 5)):
        values = [list(book[sheet].values) for book in books]
        typed = [[tuple((type(v).__name__, v) for v in row) for row in rows] for rows in values]
        assert typed[0] == typed[1]
        assert len(values[1]) == expected_rows + 1
        assert delivery["preserved_data_sheets"][sheet] == {"unchanged": True, "data_rows": expected_rows}
        formulas = sum(isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("=") for row in values[1] for v in row)
        formula_count += formulas
        sheets[sheet] = {"data_rows": expected_rows, "columns": len(values[1][0]),
                         "cells_compared_including_headers": sum(map(len, values[1])),
                         "values_and_python_types_identical": True, "formula_cells": formulas}
        new_values[sheet] = values[1]
    assert formula_count == 0
    assert list(books[0]["readme"].values) != list(books[1]["readme"].values)
finally:
    for book in books:
        book.close()
headers = new_values["P2.2 汇总"][0]
summary = [dict(zip(headers, row, strict=True)) for row in new_values["P2.2 汇总"][1:]]
low = [row for row in summary if row["auc_mean_percent"] is not None and row["auc_mean_percent"] < 50]
supplied = delivery["performance_diagnostics"]
assert supplied["not_a_new_refusal_threshold"] is True
assert supplied["row_count"] == len(low) == 31
def key(row):
    return tuple(None if row[field] == "" else row[field] for field in KEY_FIELDS)
assert Counter(key(row) for row in low) == Counter(key(row) for row in supplied["summary_rows_auc_below_50"])
for name in ("runs", "summary_rows", "run_cost_groups", "selection_rows", "summary_states", "batches",
             "max_absolute_differences", "single_config_seconds_total_no_double_count",
             "tuning_seconds_total_no_double_count", "gpu_unmeasured", "gpu_unmeasured_by_method",
             "metric_observations", "variants", "environment_combinations", "performance_diagnostics",
             "reconstructed_summary"):
    assert old_audit[name] == strict_new[name], name
report = {
    "schema_version": "p21-workbook-correction-receiving-review-1",
    "scope": "New file receipt, exact data-sheet preservation and original-audit chain, not original result-tree acceptance",
    "ok": True, "received_work_root": str(WORK.relative_to(ROOT)),
    "original_workbook": {"bytes": original.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_hash(original)},
    "corrected_workbook": {"bytes": corrected.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_hash(corrected)},
    "delivery_sha256": file_hash(delivery_path), "generator_sha256": file_hash(generator),
    "data_sheets": sheets, "changed_sheets": ["readme"],
    "frozen_original_audit_ok": True, "strict_corrected_as_original_ok": False,
    "strict_original_identity_rejections": strict_new["problems"],
    "corrected_known_legacy_definition_flags": strict_new["readme_correction_requests"],
    "numeric_reports_identical_to_audited_original": True,
    "runs": 645, "summary_rows": 183, "run_cost_groups": 129,
    "summary_states": strict_new["summary_states"], "selection_rows": strict_new["selection_rows"],
    "performance_observations": {"auc_below_50_summary_rows": len(low),
                                 "supplied_diagnostic_row_keys_verified": True,
                                 "new_rejection_threshold": False},
    "producer_gates_run": delivery["gates_run"], "producer_tests_run": delivery["tests_run"],
    "source_manifests_independently_verified": False, "source_logs_or_checkpoints_received": False,
    "uploaded_generator_executed": False, "historical_workbook_or_indices_modified": False,
    "formal_acceptance": False, "human_review_status": "pending_collaborator_review",
    "issues": [
        {"severity": "info", "code": "new_file_identity", "message": "Corrected XLSX remains a separate identity; original frozen index rejection retained"},
        {"severity": "warning", "code": "low_auc_observations", "message": "31 existing low-AUC summary observations require original artifacts for causal review; no score flipping or new threshold"},
        {"severity": "warning", "code": "original_training_artifacts_missing", "message": "Bundle contains no original manifests, plans, logs or selected weights; independent 645-run replay remains incomplete"},
        {"severity": "warning", "code": "human_review_pending", "message": "HENG958 C1-C6/RV3-RV7 review and signatures remain pending"},
    ],
}
(WORK / "correction_receiving_review.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({key: report[key] for key in ("ok", "data_sheets", "strict_original_identity_rejections", "performance_observations")}, indent=2))
